Second application was dismissed on merits vide order dated 28.03.2023 passed in MCRC 12178 of 2023.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The applicant has been arrested on 29-10-2021 in connection with Crime No.604 of 2019 registered at Police Station Goke Ka Mandir, Gwalior for offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC.
Allegation against present applicant is that he took money from different persons by giving assurance that he will provide job to them after giving scout guiding training to them and also taken Rs. 4 lac from the complainant for the same purpose.
